status: Information and behaviour specification only; no architecture or persistence implementation
assembly: Preserve original fields/hashes and role/path. Null, empty, absent, invalid, false and zero remain distinct.
Resolve explicit chosen film/entity/version bindings. A token without a binding stays unresolved; presets never become media.
Assemble only scope-relevant project/entity/scene/task claims with their provenance. Do not invent properties from unseen media or field names.
Apply only explicitly declared property-scoped authority. Layer order does not create implicit precedence. Surface incompatible or ambiguous claims for a human decision.
Retain requested timing/multi-shot/audio beside literal model controls; validate declared adapter mapping without guessing defaults or units.
Record assembled field hashes, source versions, excluded claims and decision reasons as an immutable candidate request. Preserve old requests on changes.
Keep returned candidate, further-work reuse, review and approval separate; reuse/completed status cannot approve. Human chooses task/version attempt cap as Study 09 proposes.
readiness: Missing required source/version, unresolved binding or unresolved same-property authority blocks only the proposed dispatch dependent on it. Human resolves scope; a planning model may propose, never approve or invent evidence.
validation_tests: Cross-film ID collision and duplicate role/path occurrences preserve identities and one source count.
Unseen attached image leaves lighting/material/identity contents unknown even if text names those properties.
Broad preservation with permitted relighting retains both spans and scopes; no silent last-layer-wins rule.
No-speech and appended speech instructions require a scoped human decision; no model-failure claim.
False multi_shots plus six-shot text round-trip without forced equivalence; invalid JSON supplies no controls.
A changed source/version creates a new candidate request and review causes, no automatic rerun or approval.
On authorised fixed tasks, compare complete versus scope-filtered context with independent human rubric, declared repetitions/budget; test fulfilment separately from archive prevalence.

dependencies.09: Consume merged candidate-family/review boundaries; context equivalence remains provisional
dependencies.12: Independent adjudication, adapter validation, implementation decisions and controlled benefit tests
